public abstract class Bill extends MedicalEntity implements Payable
Abstract base for a clinic bill. calculateTotal() is where each bill type's "generate bill" behavior diverges (polymorphism / overriding) â€” a plain consultation and a procedure are taxed differently, and new bill types (e.g. a lab-test bill) only need to supply their own calculateTotal().
